trades.title: Trades
trades.description: Fair deals: both teams' categories improve

edge_trades.title: Edge Trades
edge_trades.description: Edge deals: they get at least equal trade value on paper, you gain clearly more on the court

keep_player_ids.title: Keep Player Ids
keep_player_ids.description: Players never offered in trades or suggested as drops

not_for_sale_player_ids.title: Not For Sale Player Ids
not_for_sale_player_ids.description: Other teams' players their owners won't move: never targeted in trades

win_pct.title: Win Pct
win_pct.description: Chance of winning this category in an average week

league_rank.title: League Rank
league_rank.description: 1 = best weekly projection in the league

id.title: Id
id.description: tx:<id> for an ESPN move, post:<id> for a message; also the reply/reaction target

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team that made the move or wrote the post

losing_bids.title: Losing Bids
losing_bids.description: Bids this claim beat, highest first

me.description: The linked team; chat and reactions need one

page.title: Page
page.description: 0 = the last 7 days, 1 = the 7 before that, ...

token.title: Token
token.description: Only on a fresh link: send it as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' from now on

open_spot_by_trade.title: Open Spot By Trade
open_spot_by_trade.description: The spot would come from trading `drop` (he has trade value), not from releasing him

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: jewel: star name. keystone: carries a category for his team. fresh_signing: just traded for or picked up. not_for_sale: untouchable. on_the_block: on his owner's ESPN trade block.

value.title: Value
value.description: Generic z-score value summed over the league's categories

perceived_value.title: Perceived Value
perceived_value.description: Trade value in auction dollars: draft-day signals fading into % owned, rest-of-season category value and this season's production

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: core: kept by you. tradeable: has a market, trade rather than drop. droppable: replaceable from free agency. injured: out right now.

badges.title: Badges
badges.description: Why his owner holds on to him

owner_premium.title: Owner Premium
owner_premium.description: What his owner wants on top of trade value, in auction dollars

weak.title: Weak
weak.description: Categories a team is far behind in, likely punts

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.description: Signed challenge to send back to /api/team-link/verify

code.title: Code
code.description: Set this as the team's abbreviation on ESPN

my_drop.description: Who you cut to make room when you get more players

their_drop.description: Who they would likely cut to make room

my_add.description: Free agent you add to fill the spot a 2-for-1 opens on your roster

my_cats_gain.title: My Cats Gain
my_cats_gain.description: Change in my expected categories won per week

their_cats_gain.title: Their Cats Gain
their_cats_gain.description: Change in theirs, ignoring the categories they punt

edge.title: Edge
edge.description: My gain minus theirs: how much more the deal does for me

value_they_get.title: Value They Get
value_they_get.description: Perceived value they receive, in auction dollars

value_they_give.title: Value They Give
value_they_give.description: Perceived value they send, in auction dollars, including their owner premium

owner_premium.title: Owner Premium
owner_premium.description: Part of value_they_give that is owner premium on their badged players

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Jewels or keystones you give up: only suggested for a clearly better deal

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.description: Rough chance the other owner accepts (heuristic)

pitch.title: Pitch
pitch.description: Why the deal helps them, to use when you propose it

reasons.description: Why it can work for both sides: sell high, buy low, their punts, timing

category_changes.description: Change in my weekly win % per category

status.title: Status

date.title: Date
date.description: UTC day this pick is for, YYYY-MM-DD

sides.title: Sides
sides.description: The two teams; the spotlight team first

win_win_deals.title: Win Win Deals
win_win_deals.description: Deals found that work for both sides

votes.title: Votes
votes.description: 'Would you take it?' votes, by team id

drop.description: Who this team cuts to make room

cats_gain.title: Cats Gain
cats_gain.description: Change in expected categories won per week, ignoring this team's punts

category_changes.description: Change in weekly win % per category

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.description: Rough chance this owner says yes (heuristic)

pitch.title: Pitch
pitch.description: Why the deal helps this team

take.title: Take
take.description: True: that team should take the deal

voter.title: Voter
voter.description: Random id kept by the browser
